name: Hematuria
overview: Hematuria is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include presence of blood in urine. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
possibleCauses: From a clinical perspective, hematuria or haematuria is defined as the presence of blood or red blood cells in the urine.
In routine practice, hematuria may also be subtle and only detectable with a microscope or laboratory test.
In routine practice, blood that enters and mixes with the urine can come from any location within the urinary system, including the kidney, ureter, urinary bladder, urethra...
In routine practice, common causes of hematuria include urinary tract infection (UTI), kidney stones, viral illness, trauma, bladder cancer, and exercise.
In routine practice, these causes are grouped into glomerular and non-glomerular causes, depending on the involvement of the glomerulus of the kidney.
